# Hello World!

A blog must have:

- [x] auto dark mode
- [x] github pages
- [x] comments section
- [x] editable by the community
- [x] equations
- [x] Mermaid

## Find out how to format it as list!
Lets try an easier one:

- one
- two

All it was missing was a line before the list! It's a requirement for `pandoc`.

## equations
Lets see it rendering properly:

$$ x^2 + y^2 = 1 $$

## mermaid
Finally diagrams:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Hard edge] --> B(Round edge)
  B --> C{Decision}
  C --> D[Result one]
  C --> E[Result two]
```
